template_name: TEN Capital Fundraising Interview Readiness Report
description: Canonical structure of the one-page report generated at the end of every fundraising interview session. Section order, headings, field labels, source bindings, formats, item and length limits, empty-value text, the fundraising snapshot rows, the category-score rows and the footer are read from this file at runtime by app/reports/pdf_generator.py and app/reports/report_data.py. REPORT_TEMPLATE.md and readiness_report_template.pdf are generated from it. Edit this file, then run: python -m app.reports.template

document.title: FUNDRAISING INTERVIEW READINESS REPORT
document.font: Open Sans (regular, semibold, bold, italic) from app/assets/fonts; Helvetica fallback
document.money_format: Currency symbol with K/M/B suffix, up to two decimals, trailing zeros removed
document.percent_format: Up to one decimal place followed by %

readiness_levels.label: NOT YET READY FOR INVESTOR OUTREACH

data_status_vocabulary.meaning: Stated in the deck; the slide and a verbatim quote are recorded.
Entered or corrected by the founder; takes precedence over the deck.
Derived by a deterministic formula from other fields; shown with a (calculated) suffix.
Interpretation, allowed only for categorical fields; shown with an (inferred) suffix.
Not available; shown as the missing-value marker.

claim_type_vocabulary.meaning: A deck statement carrying a third-party citation.
Asserted by the deck or the founder without independent support.
A projection, target, plan or use of funds.
An interpretation, never presented as fact.

analysis_rules: Every value comes from the session: the deck-derived company profile, founder inputs, interview responses and deterministic calculations. No outside data is added.
Scores, percentages, coverage, classifications and snapshot values are calculated in Python; the model never calculates report values.
Missing information is printed as the missing-value marker and is never estimated.
Calculated and inferred snapshot values carry a (calculated) or (inferred) suffix; founder claims are never presented as verified facts.

Narrative text (assessment, concerns, next steps, practice questions) may be model-written, but every figure must trace to the deck, founder inputs or answers; any other figure is replaced with a bracketed placeholder.

Categories not covered by the interview are shown as not assessed and excluded from the overall score; the score is marked provisional when coverage is below 60% of the weighting or fewer than five answers were given.
The report must fit one page: the layout is rebuilt down the fit ladder until it does.

sections.description: Report title with run date and interview mode on the right; one metadata line; navy rule beneath.
Shaded panel with the overall score, its readiness classification (coloured by score band) and interview facts.

fields.label: Overall readiness score
fields.rule: Weighted mean of assessed category scores, rounded to an integer.

fields.label: Readiness classification
values: NOT YET READY FOR INVESTOR OUTREACH

fields.format: {answers} answers · {coverage}% of weight assessed · avg {average}/20 per answer
fields.placeholder: [N] answers · [NN]% of weight assessed · avg [NN.N]/20 per answer

fields.rule: Shown when coverage < 60% or fewer than five answers.

fields.value: Interview ended before all planned questions.
fields.rule: Shown when the founder finished before the interview completed.

sections.heading: Investor assessment
sections.description: Concise investor-oriented summary of the interview, followed by the highest-risk topic.

fields.placeholder: [Two to four sentences: overall readiness, strongest and weakest areas, and the most significant open finding.]

fields.label: Highest-risk topic
fields.rule: Interview topic with the highest risk index (100 − topic score + weighted open findings). Omitted when none.

sections.heading: Category scores
sections.description: One horizontal bar per readiness category on a 0-100 track with guides at 60 and 80, the score to the right, and the not-assessed marker for categories the interview did not cover.
sections.rule: Category score = mean response percentage of the answers on that category's topics.

sections.heading: Fundraising snapshot
sections.description: Label / value rows with hairline separators. Values carry a (calculated) or (inferred) suffix when not stated.

snapshot_rows.label: Revenue
snapshot_rows.rule: ARR when stated, otherwise annual revenue; the label follows the field used.

sections.heading: Strongest areas
sections.description: Highest-scoring assessed categories with a supporting note from the best answer in each.

sections.heading: Weakest areas
sections.description: Lowest-scoring assessed categories (never repeating a strongest area) with the main weakness from the weakest answer in each.

sections.heading: Investor concerns
sections.description: Most serious open findings from the deck analysis and weaknesses from low-scoring answers, most serious first.

sections.heading: Questions to practice
sections.description: Practice questions from the top practice-plan priorities: the actual interview question when the founder scored under 60% on it, otherwise a standard question for the category.

sections.heading: Recommended next steps
sections.description: Concrete actions to take before investor meetings, taken from the top practice-plan priorities.
sections.item_placeholder: [Concrete action to complete before investor meetings]

sections.description: Hairline rule, centred confidentiality notice, then the TEN Capital footer line in Open Sans 7 pt.
